text:
nora: FYI found a regression in inference-rb v1.3.2 around streaming reconnects. After a network drop the retry path sends the request with headers stripped (Authorization gone) and we see 401s in the sampleapp.

vik: oof. any quick repro steps?

nora: minimal repro in sampleapp streaming example: start the stream, kill the TCP connection (tcpkill locally), let the client reconnect. The retry code uses request.to_hash to copy headers and on some Ruby builds that returns {} for Net::HTTP::Post after body IO is read.

jamal: hmm could be JRuby vs MRI difference. do we mutate the original request somewhere?
nora: streaming wrapper does reuse the original request and calls to_hash. I logged headers_before_retry: {"authorization"=>"Bearer abc123..."} then headers_after_to_hash: {} before sending.

vik: thanks. open a tiny PR with a unit test that fails on current master and we can review. ideally avoid fragile Net::HTTP stubs, use a helper process to force an accept+close.
nora: opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-rb/pull/496 1 Adds a test that spawns a child TCP helper to simulate connection reset and asserts Authorization header present on retry. Also adds util deep_dup_headers in lib/redwood/http_helpers.rb.

ci-bot: triggered: rb-unit, rb-integration, macos-smoke

jamal: quick review: the deep_dup_headers helper looks good. leave a comment about why dup was insufficient (obj identity on nested arrays). Also add a changelog bullet.
nora: added comment + changelog under Unreleased -> bugfix. switched test to use Process.spawn for determinism on FreeBSD/macOS CI.

vik: nice. one more thing: sampleapp README shows the streaming example and implies transparent reconnects. might be worth a brief note in that README and a support KB entry describing patch v1.3.3 pin until rollout. onboarding folks keep hitting this.
support-bot: created ticket SUP-824: Draft KB + notify support post-release.

ci-bot: rb-unit: passed; rb-integration: failed on windows-smoke (flaky harness). tagging @nora

nora: saw that; adjusted test harness to use ephemeral ports and a short backoff instead of sleep. pushed fix.

jamal: also consider normalizing header names to downcase internally so we don't rely on header case across different HTTP libs. but deep copy is fine for now.

nora: good call. added a unit in headers_spec that checks header key normalization.

vik: LGTM. once windows-smoke stabilizes let's cut a patch release and update quickstart docs + sampleapp README. Also add a tiny e2e toggling flaky socket in sampleapp CI to catch regressions.

ci-bot: windows-smoke: passed. merging in 5s.

support-bot: SUP-824 updated: KB draft ready, will ping @support for review and include suggested pinned version v1.3.3.

jamal: thanks for the fast turnaround. this would have tripped a customer. good catch!
